subject.title: fix: skip setup-only channel plugins in outbound resolution and drain pending deliveries on qqbot reconnect

question: Should this exact-head operation-aware resolver and automatic QQBot reconnect replay become the canonical behavior for existing plugin registries?
rationale: The implementation is correct and proven, but repository policy treats plugin selection and queued-message retry changes as compatibility- and message-delivery-sensitive behavior requiring owner acceptance.

options.title: Approve canonical behavior
options.body: Land the exact-head implementation with its tested registry selection and account-scoped reconnect retry policy.

options.title: Narrow reconnect replay
options.body: Land the resolver work while deferring or further constraining automatic QQBot queue replay.

recommendation.title: Approve canonical behavior
recommendation.body: Land the exact-head implementation with its tested registry selection and account-scoped reconnect retry policy.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history directly connects this person to the outbound resolver candidate-ordering implementation extended by the PR.
